excerpt: About Us About Us Sherrill Manufacturing and our consumer brand, Liberty Tabletop, are proud to represent something increasingly rare in America, flatware that is still made here at home. Family-owned and operated in Sherrill, New York, we have proudly been in business for more than 21 years. While our company itself is modern, our roots run deep. We are honored to operate inside a factory that has been producing flatware for more than a century, carrying forward a proud tradition of American craftsmanship that few companies in the world still practice today. At the heart of our company is our workforce, the men and women we proudly consider family.
